subject: Helpers needed for Data Carpentry-based workshops

messages.subject: Helpers needed for Data Carpentry-based workshops
parts:
Hi D-RUG members,

The Data Management Program with the DSI is running a series of workshops based on the Data Carpentry curriculum. We need a helper of two this coming Thursday, 2/14 from 2 to 4 PM and two-three helpers for the next sessions on 2/21 and 2/28 also between 2-4 PM. The workshops on the 14th and 21st are splitting the "Starting with data" module (https://datacarpentry.org/R-ecology-lesson/02-starting-with-data.html), and the last session is on "Manipulating data frames" (https://datacarpentry.org/R-ecology-lesson/03-dplyr.html).
Thank you for considering,

Vessela Ensberg
